text:
kevin: FYI — customer acme-corp says their monthly credits went to 0 right after midnight local time even though refill job ran. They saw credits at 23:50 and zero at 00:05 local.
sasha: Which timezone? DST changes recently?
kevin: Europe/Paris (CET -> CEST) — they flipped clocks last night.
maria: I pulled the tenant record. Refill job ran at 02:00 UTC per logs. Tenant timezone is Europe/Paris so that maps to 04:00 local? odd.
kevin: Here's the raw API reply when I polled the tenant:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <svc-token>" -H "X-Org: acme-corp" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenant/credits
# -> {"available":0,"next_refill":"2026-03-29T22:00:00Z","timezone":"Europe/Paris","last_refill":"2026-03-28T22:00:00Z"}
```
support-engineer-amy: Customer also reported a long streaming session that spanned midnight. They didn't reconnect until later. Could the client keep a cached view of the bucket during an active session?
sasha: Yes — UI cache TTL + websocket session state can show stale token counts until a reconnect or a credits-poll. The refill job updates DB, but some display/cache layers only refresh on session start.
billing-bot: Billing pipeline: refill executed for tenant acme-corp at 2026-03-29T22:00:00Z (job id job_8f3b).
oncall-kevin: Assigning to @oncall-kevin for infra logs and quick mitigation.
oncall-kevin: I see from access logs the customer's streaming session kept a persistent connection from 2026-03-28T23:10:00+01:00 to 2026-03-29T00:20:00+02:00 (clock shifted). The display cache key was never invalidated.
support-engineer-amy: Repro steps for internal: 1) create tenant in Europe/Paris 2) open long websocket streaming session spanning local midnight 3) let refill job run in UTC-mapped window 4) observe UI showing 0 while DB shows refill applied.
kevin: Short-term mitigation: ask customer to reconnect the session or call GET /v1/tenant/credits (forces cache refresh). Long-term: invalidate display cache on refill event and make websocket state aware of refill events.
sasha: Can infra add a TTL change for flagged tenants for next 24h? setting display cache TTL=30s for tenants with DST swap detected would reduce hits.
oncall-kevin: Will roll a quick change to reduce TTL for the flagged tenant group; patch will be canary first.
maria: Notifying customer: "We identified a UI/session cache mismatch around DST/streaming sessions. Temporary fix: please reconnect your session or call the credits endpoint. We're pushing a short TTL mitigation and a durable fix to invalidate client sessions on refill"
support-engineer-amy: Customer accepted workaround and reconnected — credits now show. They requested a postmortem for potential other tenants.
kevin: Action items: (1) infra: short TTL canary (2) platform: emit refill event to session service so sessions refresh (3) billing: confirm refill job timezone handling is correct (it ran ok).
sasha: Marking as P2 and adding to weekly postmortem queue. :thumbsup:
kevin: Closing thread once canary is up and we confirm no other tenants impacted.
